cc:Work.dc:title: Per-branch average current
cc:Work.dc:description: Four same-scale dot panels compare branch means. Module 2 has 8.988 mA in its single-module reference; the N=4 Module 1 branch mean is 8.189 mA. Absent modules are labelled not in run.
